title: Review records the fix check writes are readable by merge --reviewed
why:
Incidents (coordinator 13:59 CST Nov 12): the records on #2860 and #2904 were unreadable by --reviewed.

GitHub REST read 00:08 CST Nov 15 (Degen feedback status pass, triage fork; no diff read): its PR #2940 is an open draft, last updated Nov 12. #3116 (restarted rounds refused, ledger row D25) merged Nov 13.

Lane fix-check-reads-red-job-wakes 00:21 CST Nov 15 (relayed; triage read no code or diff): merging main into #2940 leaves 4 of its new tests failing in merge/test_merge.py (ReviewedList x3 expect "open: the fix check passed, but no round is recorded"; one: guard yes owes the final round) and a 5th (usage phrase "--fix-check MODEL must be sonnet", a plain re-point). Two kinds of case. Round 1 FAIL then a passing fix check: main reads done (decision pr-review-record, done rules: "a fix verifier PASSes after that round (a FAIL round too)"; CLAUDE.md roles-review-cap-three: a small fix to a round's finding gets a fix verifier and merges on green), so that test is a plain re-point. A passing fix check with no round recorded at its head (log at another head or PR, an earlier log with its own fix check, or a bare hold): ruling own-741-a-lint-fix-no-r3 covers only a lint fix after a passed round, so the owner has the question (waiting-page item 858, pick-fix-verifier-no-round-recorded; options a ends review as main reads today, b needs a round at the same head, c a round on the same PR counts; none starred). Lane holds #2940, pushes nothing, re-points only the usage phrase. #2860 stays blocked by #2940.

11:45 CST Nov 15 (triage): owner answered page item 858 a at 11:39:47 CST (ruling own-858-a-fix-verifier-ends-review): a passing fix verifier ends review even when no round is recorded at its head. PR 2940 keeps main's pr-review-record reading; its 4 tests that expect "open: the fix check passed, but no round is recorded" re-point, red then green. Lane holds 2940 no longer on this question; hand-in is the coordinator's act, triage sent no message.

Covers #2904 and #2860 shapes of record-before-fix-push. Lane 15:31 CST Nov 12: #2940 (head 664aafccd) handed in. Open gap: a PR with an unrelated record at another head still refuses a --fix-check line. Retrospective 23:27 CST Nov 12, Degen D25 (batch 3): Degen restarted at round 1 six times on Nov 12 after a passed fix check (597 to 635 to 656; 605 to 667; 645; 674; 567). Root cause read on main 36807ad19, merge/merge.py usage: --fix-check takes HEAD only when it is the Head of the newest earlier record on the PR. #2940 (this step, R55 express) covers a PR with no record at all; the PR-with-other-records ... 11:36 CST Nov 18 (triage 11): PR 2940 now reads closed, not merged (REST); rebuilt under step fix-check-other-records (coordinator).
PR 2940 closed unmerged, lane archived; rechecked by REST 2026-11-18 21:30 CST (triage 12). Back to todo.
